row.notes: vtable of game::FECareerDLCSelectViewModel, the fe_career_dlc_select screen (the 2025 and 2026 career tiles of Driver Career and My Team). The screen factory 0x141649f80 allocates 0x3b0 bytes, calls the tile-screen base constructor 0x141a482f0(vm, ..., "fe_career_dlc_select" 0x14573841b, ...), loads the vtable with the lea at 0x14164bc82 (its disp32 at 0x14164bc85 is the only reference to it) and stores it with mov [r15],rax at 0x14164bc89; the next stores set +0x260 = 0x1457384d0, +0x268 = 0x1457384f8 and +0x298 = 0x145738508, and 0x14164bcb6 writes the word 0x0600 at +0x3a8 (+0x3a8 = 0 is the sub kind, +0x3a9 = 6 the menu kind, the career content case of FeTile_Build_List). Slot 10 (0x145738480) = Game_FECareerDLCSelectViewModel_OnCommandRaised 0x141bad270; slot 13 (0x145738498) = 0x141bad190, which calls the tile-screen tile build 0x141a48b10. That build allocates a TileList (0xc8 bytes, vtable 0x145706aa0), stores it at view model+0x2c8 and passes it to FeTile_Build_List (return address 0x141a48cc9, seen at a site_FeTile_CareerContentEnd breakpoint with the list in r14, the view model as the saved rsi and view model+0x358 = 0). [view model+0x10]+8 is the root handle 0x141a48b10 passes to 0x1442bba60.

The lea at 0x14164bc82 loads 0x145738430; its disp32 at 0x14164bc85 is the only reference to the vtable anywhere in the exe, so only this factory installs it. The next stores write +0x260 = 0x1457384d0, +0x268 = 0x1457384f8 and +0x298 = 0x145738508, and 0x14164bcb6 writes the word 0x600 at +0x3a8. The vtable has 19 non-null slots before the null at 0x1457384c8 (0x1457384d0 is the +0x260 secondary table). Slot 10 holds 0x141bad270, whose pretty-function string names game::FECareerDLCSelectViewModel::onCommandRaised. Slot 13 holds 0x141bad190, which is call 0x141a48b10, then mov cl,0x21 and jmp 0x143859690. 0x141a48b10 does mov edx,0xc8 and align 0x10 through [vm+0x2b8], stores vtable 0x145706aa0 (lea at 0x141a48b56) into the new object, stores it at vm+0x2c8 (0x141a48bfc) and passes it as rcx (0x141a48cbe) to FeTile_Build_List at 0x141a48cc4 (return 0x141a48cc9). In the base vtable 0x145734720, slots 10 and 13 are 0x141a499c0 and 0x141a48b10. [vm+0x10]+8 is the handle that 0x141a48b10 passes to 0x1442bba60 (0x141a48c56); the base ctor 0x153c43960 zeroes +0x10. That fits a root handle, but I did not find the write. sigcheck OK, one hit. Two details are wrong. First, 0x14164bc82 is the lea that loads the vtable; the store is mov [r15],rax at 0x14164bc89. Second, the menu and sub kinds are swapped. The word 0x0600 puts 0x00 at +0x3a8 and 0x06 at +0x3a9. 0x141a48b10 passes byte +0x3a9 as FeTile_Build_List arg 5, menu_kind ([rsp+0x20] at 0x141a48cb2), and byte +0x3a8 as arg 6, sub_kind ([rsp+0x28] at 0x141a48cad). FeTile_Build_List loads r12b from arg 5 (0x14173e39d) and runs its outer switch on it (0x14173e6a2). So this screen is menu kind 6, sub kind 0, i.e. outer case 6 (career content). It is not menu kind 0, sub kind 6. The runtime breakpoint observation (vm+0x358 = 0) and the Driver Career / My Team scope were not re-checked.
